title: Implement barcode and QR-code product identification

checks.name: model
checks.description: Product has an optional trimmed unique barcode field that remains compatible with legacy records.

checks.name: creation
checks.description: Product creation assigns a missing barcode and rejects duplicate codes with a 409 response.

checks.name: lookup
checks.description: An authenticated lookup route returns the populated product and handles unknown codes with 404.

checks.name: frontend-lookup
checks.description: Redux and the product page provide manual code lookup and display the resolved product or error.

checks.name: frontend-scanning
checks.description: The page uses BarcodeDetector when available, supports QR/barcode formats, and preserves a manual fallback.
